rules: STRICT: Never use hex codes (e.g., #5B9BD5) in components.
STRICT: Never use arbitrary Tailwind values (e.g., bg-[#5B9BD5]).
ALWAYS: Use the semantic functional classes: 'bg-primary', 'text-grey', 'btn-primary', etc.
If a color or spacing value is needed that isn't in Tailwind, check designTokens.ts but apply it via a Tailwind alias.
Always use the brand colors defined in designTokens.ts
Primary buttons must use the .btn-primary utility class
Ensure all API routes are protected by middleware for /admin paths
Use Server Components by default, add 'use client' only when necessary
All currency must be formatted in South African Rands (ZAR)
All pages with database queries must export 'export const dynamic = 'force-dynamic'' at the top of the file.
Sanitize all auth errors before rendering to UI — use sanitizeAuthError() from @/lib/auth-utils.
Sanitize all database/form errors before rendering to UI — use sanitizeFormError() from @/lib/auth-utils.
Use named imports from lucide-react for tree-shaking. Never import '* as Icons' from lucide-react.
Never render raw error.message from Supabase directly to the UI.
All database tables must have RLS enabled in schema.sql with appropriate policies.
Admin check functions must use SECURITY DEFINER in Postgres.
When wrapping Button in Link for navigation, pass href to CTA prop and let the component handle the Link wrapper.
